description: Deterministic hard vetoes for the pre-investment entry gate. A veto cannot be outweighed by passing checks. Industry exceptions are encoded here so they are reviewable, never improvised in prose; every exception requires its own evidence row in the artifact.

vetoes.description: Documented fraud, restatement, auditor resignation, undisclosed related-party dealing, or a regulator sanctioning management for disclosure conduct.
Who pays, for what, and why it repeats cannot be stated in one sentence from primary sources.
Operating cash flow negative across the available comparable history with no funded, dated path to positive.

exceptions.note: Pre-approval clinical programs are expected to burn cash; the exception needs a funded runway through the next binary readout.
Capital-intensive build-out before first revenue; the exception needs a committed financing package and a dated commissioning schedule.

vetoes.description: Share count growing faster than the business it funds, or repeated below-market issuance without a stated accretive use.

exceptions.note: Equity is the standard funding instrument pre-approval; the exception needs the raise tied to a named program milestone.
